# Rotate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Rotates a native subtree clockwise without rasterising its content.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Rotate(options?: RotateOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`angle`](#angle): Finite clockwise degrees, default zero.
- [`child`](#child): The native subtree to rotate.
- [`contentWidth`](#contentwidth): Optional positive child width before rotation, in points.
- [`mode`](#mode): Free keeps the flow box; constrained accepts multiples of 90 degrees.

### `angle`

angle: number
```

Finite clockwise degrees, default zero.

```

The native subtree to rotate.
